paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Number of tasks by language family.
model_annotation: The bar chart, titled "Number of tasks by language family," illustrates the distribution of tasks across various language families as studied in the paper "Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models." The horizontal axis represents the number of tasks, scaled from 0 to 80, while the vertical axis lists the language families: IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque. The length of each horizontal bar corresponds to the number of tasks associated with that language family. The IE-Slavic family has the highest number of tasks, with a value of approximately 79. The IE-Romance family follows with about 47 tasks, and the IE-Germanic family has around 44 tasks. The remaining families have fewer tasks, with IE-Baltic at approximately 17, IE-other at about 15, IE-Indic at roughly 10, Semitic at around 8, Turkic at about 5, and Basque at the lowest, with approximately 4 tasks. The bars are sorted in descending order of task count from top to bottom.
